fields.summary: Login fails with 500 error when password contains special characters
fields.description:
When users attempt to log in with passwords containing special characters such as &, <, >, or ', the server returns a 500 Internal Server Error. The issue was first reported by multiple users and reproduced consistently.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Navigate to login page
2. Enter a valid email
3. Enter a password containing & or < character
4. Click Login

Expected: Successful login
Actual: 500 error

comments.body: Confirmed on production. Multiple users reported this.
Root cause: input sanitization is not applied before passing to the auth service.
